title: SimGHOSTS 2026 USA Conference
summary: The SG26USA "Waves of Innovation: Navigating Excellence in Healthcare Simulation" conference is August 4-7, 2026 at Saginaw Valley State University in Michigan. This 3.5 day event brings Simulation Operations and Technology Specialists together for hands-on training, skill-building and community connection.
body_markdown:
The SG26USA "Waves of Innovation: Navigating Excellence in Healthcare Simulation" conference is August 4-7, 2026 at Saginaw Valley State University in Michigan. This 3.5 day event brings Simulation Operations and Technology Specialists together for hands-on training, skill-building and community connection.
